readings.K1: A run's C-full cost is its job slot (slot_s: start to end inside the pod, every in-job stage, the O-ext pass included) / 2,934 s, the definition FRE itself uses (a job slot); pod overhead is per pod and is not in a job's ledger. The stage split (stages_s) is printed beside it. Alternative: the sum of the stages.
readings.K2: Under C-lean a full run (an arm, a0, or a reference trained by another recipe) is one lean job, so it costs 1 c0 by the convention's definition (the frozen selector spec's C-lean unit is its own lean job); c0 is measured once (the c0 job's slot) and no run's own lean job ran, so a run's C-lean cost is not measured per run. Recipe G's and B+Qi's training differ from R's (REV4:827 prices B+Qi at 6.7-6.9 c0 for 6 seeds in the dev-100 form, E), and the readable ledger cannot separate a run's training from its evaluation (one -calibrate step), so their 1 c0 leaves that training difference out (E: a few per cent at the 500-prompt form; c_lean_note). Every other job whose work does not change with the convention (the diagnostics, the scorers and the study costs: regenerations, O-only passes, the transfer report, the certification jobs, b10_certify among them) costs its measured seconds / the measured c0, as REV4:823 converts a0's regeneration (0.077 h: 0.094 FRE and 0.32 c0). The B10 references: K6. Alternative: the frozen lean price (about 2,386 s) / the measured c0 for every run.
readings.K3: Diagnostics are charged by CHARGES (L1: l1_scan and rep_pass; S3: untuned_answers and rep_pass; S4: untuned_answers; A1: Gate B's w0b-2 diagnostics, 3.04 h, outside the kit) to the reading's arms only; a job shared by two of the reading's arms is charged whole to each, with the split (equal shares among the reading's arms that use it) as the second number (LS-13's rule for the representation pass, applied to the untuned answers too). The split's denominator is the reading's arms only: the representation pass also serves DataShield-style (REQ-12, a stage-1c secondary arm, not a stage-1 arm), Gate C's reproduction and stage 1b's plant and decoy pools, none charged here, so each share is an upper (charging.split_denominator). A job no arm of the reading uses (rep_pass under plan B) is printed by kind only. An arm one of whose kinds has no complete job with a ledger gets no charge (null, with the reason), never 0. H1, S1, R and a0 have no kit diagnostic. Mac work (REQ-7, REQ-11's scoring, the S-pool, the length sort) has no ledger: H1's and S1's diagnostic prints 0 GPU-seconds with that note. REV4:796's anchor job (Gate B's anchor-1 job, which made A1's and L1's anchor bank) is named in charging.anchor_job and not priced here: it is outside the kit, like A1's w0b-2 job. Alternative: the lead's own map.
readings.K4: The reused a0 and R units at 1101-1103 ran in Gate A and wave 0a: their runs are not in the stage-1 ledgers, so an arm's run cost is the mean over its seeds in the kit; their regenerations and O-only passes are study costs, reported apart. Alternative: wave 0a's ledgers for R (REV4 10.2's table).
readings.K5: References: ref_train runs (recipe G, B+Qi) are runs like an arm's; a B10 job (ref_eval, safe_lora) is printed whole and, where its steps name a point (Safe LoRA's transform and evaluate steps), per point under C-full from the measured steps; Safe LoRA's -b10-regenerate step (a0's regeneration) is the study cost reported apart. ref_eval's one -b10-run step holds every point and a0's regeneration, so its C-full cost is measured whole only (includes_a0_regeneration); each ref_eval point's C-full cost is K8's (REV4:813), and this reading's 'null: not stated' is printed beside it (alternative_k5) as the alternative. Alternative: an equal split of the whole over its points.
readings.K6: Under C-lean a B10 reference state is evaluation-only: REV4:813's rule for an evaluation-only reference (the same minus training, plus its transform) applied to C-lean's lean job, as REV4 10.4 prices it (:825, one evaluation-only state 0.75 c0 in the dev-100 form = (15 + 635) / 870 s at the frozen lean prices). A B10 job runs the full evaluation (eval_adapter.py: the engine's evaluation, then O-ext), so its measured seconds are C-full work, and no lean evaluation-only job ran. One lean state = the measured c0 less the frozen lean training price (LEAN_TRAINING_S, 220 s: REV4:636; selector_spec.json C-lean variant a), so it holds the measured lean evaluation at the run's own O cap; a point's C-lean cost = one lean state + its transform's measured seconds (Safe LoRA's -transform-P step; ref_eval's scaling and prefix transforms run inside its one step and are not added: about 0). A Safe LoRA job's whole C-lean cost = its slot with each -evaluate-P step replaced by one lean state; ref_eval's whole is not split (one step), so its C-lean cost is per point only. The B10 kinds are not in diagnostics_by_kind. Alternatives: REV4 10.4's form, the frozen lean evaluation price (15 + 2,151.2 = 2,166.2 s at the full cap) over the measured c0 (it overstates under Branch 128's cap, and a c0 below 2,166.2 s would price one state above a whole lean run); or no C-lean value for B10 (null).
readings.K7: REV4:632's median of all stage-1 R arms = the median job slot (seconds and FRE) of the complete stage-1 R runs with a ledger in the reading's blocks (the reused R units at 1101-1103 ran in wave 0a); report only, beside the fixed 1 FRE, which it never re-estimates. A stage-1 slot holds the 400 PHTest answers (LN-33), so it exceeds the wave-0a basis by design. Alternative: the median slot without the -oext step (wave 0a's 468 prompts).
readings.K8: REV4:813 read literally for the ref_eval points (adapter scaling 0.9, 0.75, 0.5 and the prefix, SP; REV4:774 needs their cost under both conventions): 'the same' is the C-full cost of the full run the reference is built on, the a0 run at the same seed (the kit runs each ref_eval job on block B's own a0 run at its seed: plan_tool K1, stage1_rules SECOND_PHASE_KINDS), so a point's C-full cost = the matched a0 run's measured slot (K1: start to end inside the pod, the O-ext pass included, as the point's own evaluation holds it) - the frozen C-full training price (FULL_TRAINING_S, 219.7 s: selector_spec.json C-full training_s, the median training of R_1-R_3, REV4:804-806; not the lean 220 s) + the job ledger's measured transform stage (the runner records a transform stage only for Safe LoRA, so a ref_eval ledger's is 0: its scalar on the adapter weights and its prompt prefix run inside the one -b10-run step), over 2,934 s (c_full_fre; the same seconds over the measured c0 beside it, OVER_C0_NOTE). The a0 run is named (c_full_basis.a0_run); a seed with no complete a0 run with a ledger in the reading's blocks gets null with the reason. b10_per_reference prints, per B10 kind and point, the mean (min, max) over the jobs' seeds of c_full_fre and c_lean_c0, listing a seed without a value; two complete jobs at one seed refuse. Safe LoRA's points keep their measured per-point C-full (K5). Alternatives: K5's null (printed beside it as alternative_k5); an equal split of the ref_eval slot over its points (it includes a0's regeneration, a study cost); the same seed's measured Safe LoRA -evaluate-P step as the price of one full evaluation-only state.
